claims.text: This excerpt shows a series of system log events related to the initialization of the CBS (Component-Based Servicing) and CSI (Component Store Interface) on a Windows system.
The events indicate that startup processing was not required and terminated normally, and that two CBS sessions were initialized by the Windows Update Agent.
The CSI store was also initialized, and an NT transaction was created and resulted in success, as indicated by the result code 0x00000000.
